standard_prerequisites.name: The cone of a map of complexes and the criterion for producing a map into a shift of a cone from a map plus an explicit homotopy
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6034-6043) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Formulate the canonical comparison map that the statement requires.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Description of the naive cotangent complex through stalks, and the algebraic exact sequence for a composition of ring maps
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked near the end of the counted proof (source lines 6055-6059) as pointers to a lemma of this chapter and to a result of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduce the exactness statement to the corresponding algebraic statement.

core_obligations: Construct the comparison map: to give the map to the shift of the cone the proof must provide a map between the complexes together with a homotopy between the composite with the given map and zero (proof lines 6034-6043)

Provide the map and the homotopy: the first map is given by the functoriality of the construction for the evident commutative diagram, and the homotopy is written down explicitly on generators, comparing with the algebraic remark (proof lines 6044-6054)

Reduce the exactness: the resulting six term exact sequence of cohomology sheaves follows once the first map induces an isomorphism in degree zero and a surjection in degree minus one (proof lines 6055-6056)
Check on stalks: those statements may be checked on stalks, where they are the corresponding algebraic statement for a composition of ring maps (proof lines 6057-6059)
proof_roadmap: 为给出 c：NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C → C[-1]（C 为映射 NL_{C/A} → NL_{C/B} 的锥），按跨章「映射到锥的移动」判据，需要给出 c_1 : NL_{B/A} ⊗_B C → NL_{C/A} 以及它与后接映射复合到零的同伦；c_1 由函子性给出，同伦在生成元上显式规定为 d[b] ⊗ 1 ↦ [φ(b)] - b[1]。
六项正合列只需 H^0(c) 同构、H^{-1}(c) 满；可由茎检验（lemma-stalk-NL），于是化为交换代数中的同一命题（跨章引理）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a canonical map from the base change of the naive cotangent complex of an intermediate ring to the shift of the cone of the map between the outer two complexes, and derives from it a six term exact sequence of cohomology sheaves (author lemma at source lines 6002-6031, label lemma-exact-sequence-NL). The proof (source lines 6033-6061) constructs the map by the cone criterion, giving the first component by functoriality and writing down an explicit homotopy on generators, and then reduces the resulting exactness statement to the algebraic statement of the same shape by checking on stalks (proof lines 6044-6059). The explicit homotopy and the reduction to stalks are the content; the author closes with the remark that some details are omitted. H3.
